January and February are Midsummer in Rio! Here at world-
famous Copacabana Beach you can stroll, hatless, along hand-set
mosaic sidewalks and laugh at ice and snow. Pan American. the
world's most experienced international airline, has made possible a
new, more exciting kind of winter vacation in distant foreign lands.
